import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot = survival_pivot.reindex(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF69B4', '#4169E1'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
not_survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([not_survived_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Not Survived', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#FF6B6B', '#51CF66'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count']).reset_index()
embark_survival['rate'] = embark_survival['sum'] / embark_survival['count']
embark_labels = {'S': 'Southampton', 'C': 'Cherbourg', 'Q': 'Queenstown'}
embark_survival['port'] = embark_survival['embarked'].map(embark_labels)
embark_survival = embark_survival.dropna()
bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival['port'], embark_survival['rate'], 
               color=['#FFB347', '#77DD77', '#AEC6CF'], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.2%}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Fare distribution by class with survival overlay
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for cls, color in zip(['First', 'Second', 'Third'], ['#FFD700', '#C0C0C0', '#CD7F32']):
    class_data = df[df['class'] == cls]
    survived_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare']
    not_survived_fare = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 0]['fare']
    
    parts = ax4.violinplot([survived_fare.dropna()], positions=[['First', 'Second', 'Third'].index(cls) * 2],
                           widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
    for pc in parts['bodies']:
        pc.set_facecolor(color)
        pc.set_alpha(0.6)
    
    parts2 = ax4.violinplot([not_survived_fare.dropna()], positions=[['First', 'Second', 'Third'].index(cls) * 2 + 0.8],
                            widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
    for pc in parts2['bodies']:
        pc.set_facecolor(color)
        pc.set_alpha(0.3)

ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class (Darker=Survived)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticks([0.4, 2.4, 4.4])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
